core.allHidden: nothing to show: every shape of the mesh is hidden
core.badEngine: chain %(chain)r: engine %(engine)r, but smp or cbpc was expected
core.boundsMismatch: block %(block)d of shape %(shape)r: the sphere in the file (%(centre)s, %(radius).3f) does not match what PyNifly read - the layout is unknown, refusing to write
core.boundsNeedMorphs: no morphs open: without them the needed sphere is the rest sphere, nothing to write
core.capsuleIndex: bone %(bone)r has %(count)d capsules, and %(index)d was asked for
core.emptySet: the set is empty: name at least one slider
core.morphMovesNothing: morph %(morph)r moves not a single vertex of the mesh
core.noMeshOpen: open a mesh first: open(<path to .nif>)
core.noMorphFile: no morph file is open for this mesh
core.noOverwriteMesh: writing over the source mesh is refused: name a new file
core.noSkeletonOpen: open a skeleton first: open_skeleton(<path to skeleton.nif>)
core.nothingToDraw: nothing to draw: every shape of the mesh is hidden
core.outsideData: under MO2 browsing is limited to the game Data folder: %(data)s
core.pairOrder: pair order: max or gain, not %(value)r
